entries.mechanism: Every NYC ECPS school-tax rate-reduction mismatch is a second-band case. Axiom follows the IT-201 instruction table's printed rounded base amounts ($37, $21, and $25), while PolicyEngine models the component as a marginal-rate table and derives the carry-in from the first-band threshold and rate. That produces constant sub-dollar residuals by filing-status group, with first-band, zero/negative, and over-limit cases matching.

The composed NYC final-liability ECPS residuals are produced by the same printed-base-versus-derived-carry-in convention at the section 11-1701 base-tax layer. Axiom follows NYC Administrative Code section 11-1701's printed base-tax amounts and then composes the separate section 11-1704.1 fourteen-percent additional tax. PolicyEngine uses the current IT-201 combined marginal rates and derives carry-ins from thresholds and combined rates, producing stable sub-dollar residuals for tax units above the final section 11-1701 bracket threshold.
